judgments.reason: The premise is based on a contradicted stat and actual data shows coal dropped to 3.41%, indicating the phase-out is nearly complete.
Relying on a single fuel source for 79.7% of power generation logically constitutes the primary system vulnerability.
Since gas accounts for nearly 80% of total generation, a supply disruption would inherently affect most of the power grid.
